_readme: Controls which Halo MCP tools the voice agent can use. Rules are checked in order; first match wins.
kind: read | create_ticket | add_note | deny. 'match' is a tool name or a glob (* wildcard), case-insensitive.
Tools that match no rule are allowed only if the MCP server marks them readOnlyHint=true (and allowReadOnlyAnnotated is true).
Run `npm run list-tools` against your Halo instance and adjust the names below to match.
Write policy agreed for the PoC: create tickets + add notes to the caller's own tickets. Nothing else.

identify._readme: Optional pre-call caller lookup. {phone} is replaced with each phone variant (E.164 and local 0... form). Delete this block to let the agent identify the caller itself.
